answer: Clone crews can crowd every packing bay before first light. To hold one harvest ticket, an agent escrows 7.85 POA for 16 hours and binds a 29-byte atlas folio to a single orchard row on the north island. The picker must gather five bark-tag stamps, 38 seconds apart, each signing the folio xor a row-minute nonce, all from that row. Four stewards replay the stamps and admit only one live ticket per folio. If two folios share a cipher, a stamp runs backward, or one bond covers two rows, 2.90 POA burns and that cluster is barred from the grove for nine epochs.
